map.浸酸为什么要加盐？: Why is salt added in pickling?
map.低 pH 下裸皮会严重酸膨胀，加入足量食盐（通常 6%~10%）可抑制膨胀、保护: At low pH the bare hide swells severely with acid, and adding enough salt (usually 6%~10%) suppresses the swelling and protects the fibers; insufficient salt is a common cause of pickling accidents.
map.目标 pH 越低酸量增长越快吗？: Does the acid amount grow faster at a lower target pH?
map.按本经验模型，pH 每降低 1，酸占皮重约增加 0.5%；但实际缓冲效应使酸耗非: In this empirical model, each 1-unit drop in pH adds about 0.5% acid relative to hide weight; in reality buffering makes acid consumption grow non-linearly, so the low pH range needs more care and the measured pH is authoritative.
